question: If ab + bc + ca = 0, then find the value of (1)/(a²-b c)+(1)/(b²-c a)+(1)/(c²-a b).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

Value putting method:

a = 2, b = -1 , c = 2 (as it satisfied ab + bc + ca = 0)

So,

 (1)/(a²-b c)+(1)/(b²-c a)+(1)/(c²-a b)

⇒ (1)/(4+2)+(1)/(1-4)+(1)/(4+2)</sp
